identity_paragraph: 14-year-old Navajo girl with a warm tan complexion and dark brown eyes, silky straight black hair in two long wrapped mid-back braids tied with turquoise hair ties, no loose hair, no bun, broad warm optimistic smile with full warm color in her face, traditional turquoise ring with a plain woven belt and a closed multi-tool knife held down at her side, cadette scout vest with patches over a turquoise shirt and modest full-length uniform pants, animated comic-book style with heavy brush ink outlines, turquoise-and-copper watercolor-bleed halftone shading, calligraphic ink strokes, plain warm-white background.
